title: Trauma Chameleon
description: Found sounds and staccato words punctuate the action as a mouse darts around the screen, chased by the unravelling springs of a mouse trap. Drawn directly onto film, this joyfully original piece of work can also be seen online, as part of our experimental animation strand: Depth Perceptions.
producers: Gina Kamentsky The devil dances in empty pockets. From the ever reliable Miyu Distribution comes this dark fairy tale of secrecy and greed. After witnessing a violent crime
seven children are drawn into a pact of silence
where they discover it becomes impossible to return to their innocent world.
